title: Unified logging orchestration Terraform module for Cloud audit pipelines and index lifecycle
creator: Anika Shah
description:
Goal: implement a reusable Terraform module that orchestrates audit log collection and retention for Private (VPC) deployments. The module will provision cross-account CloudTrail aggregation (when applicable), S3 buckets with KMS encryption and lifecycle rules, and an OpenSearch ingestion path with configurable ILM (index lifecycle management) policies. It must be deployable into customer VPCs (supporting VPC endpoints), support both self-hosted OpenSearch and managed domains, and provide observability/healthchecks for ingestion and storage components.

Scope:
- Terraform module (root module + submodules) that creates: CloudTrail configuration (multi-region option), bucket lifecycle rules (transition to Glacier+Glacier Deep Archive), KMS key with least-privileged IAM roles, OpenSearch index templates + ILM policies, ingestion Lambda or Firehose configuration, VPC endpoint resources and security-group examples, and healthcheck CloudWatch metrics + alarm integration.
- Upgrade/migration helpers: scripts/TF plan guidance for rolling upgrades of index templates, reindexing strategy for breaking mapping changes, and automated acceptance tests.
- CI: GitHub Actions workflow to validate module with Terratest against a sandbox AWS account and to run fmt/lint/security static checks.

Non-goals: building a full observability stack (we integrate with existing Console dashboards via metrics/events), replacing customer-managed logging pipelines, or supporting proprietary ELK plugins.

Acceptance criteria:
- Module can be instantiated in a sandbox VPC and produce ingestible OpenSearch indexes within 30m.
- Default retention policy set to 90 days but fully configurable to 0-3650 days.
- Cross-account aggregation works when provided with an aggregator account ID; artifacts include IAM roles and bucket policies.
- Healthcheck Lambda emits metrics for S3 delivery success/failure and OpenSearch ingestion lag; alerts fire to existing PagerDuty channel.
- Upgrade docs and a migration runbook are present in the repo (CONFLUENCE links in attachments).

Design notes and trade-offs:
- We default to OpenSearch (open-source forks) because it avoids vendor lock-in and keeps operational cost predictable for private installs; however the module includes a toggle to use managed Elastic Cloud with compatible index templates.
- Using Firehose + Lambda for transformation allows safe schema evolution and light-weight enrichment (enrich with org_id, env, request_id). Cost trade-off: Firehose has slightly higher cost but lower operational burden than a fleet of ingestion EC2 workers.
- Retention lifecycle defaults to move to Glacier after 90 days and Deep Archive after 2 years; this balances storage cost vs. legal/forensics needs. All transitions configurable.
- KMS keys are customer-owned by default for Private installs; we provide an option to use platform-managed key for Hosted environments.

Outputs & variables (high level):
- variables: retention_days, enable_cross_account, aggregator_account_id, use_managed_opensearch, vpc_endpoint_ids, kms_key_alias, enable_healthchecks, create_firehose.
- outputs: s3_bucket_arn, opensearch_domain_endpoint, healthcheck_lambda_arn, ilm_policy_id, index_template_id.

Backward compatibility & upgrade path:
- We will ship the module with a migration script (Python CLI) that can reindex old indices into new index templates using scroll/bulk reindex pattern. The module will avoid breaking mapping changes by releasing new templates with a version suffix and providing an operator-run switch to flush older indices.
- For schema changes that are incompatible, the runbook describes: create new index template v2 -> create empty rollover alias -> reindex using transient workers -> switch alias atomically -> delete old indices after verification.
- Upgrade automation: GH Actions job (dry-run) that runs terraform plan with the customer's state snapshot and posts drift notes to a PR for manual approval before apply.

Testing & validation:
- Terratest cases to validate: basic deployment, cross-account trail forwarding, bucket lifecycle verification, ILM policy application, healthcheck alarms firing on simulated delivery failures.
- E2E smoke test: ingest synthetic audit events, verify they appear in OpenSearch with expected enrichment tags and that S3 lifecycle transitions are scheduled.

Operational concerns:
- Ensure logs are immutable for the retention window by preventing delete actions on buckets except via lifecycle transitions and ensuring bucket policies restrict s3:DeleteObject for the audit path.
- Provide a lightweight dashboard in Console that surfaces per-customer indexing lag, S3 storage growth, and recent KMS key usage (metrics exported to CloudWatch).

Deliverables:
- terraform/modules/logging-orchestration (root module + submodules)
- examples/vpc-audit-deployments (example usages for common customer topologies)
- docs/migration-runbook.md (Confluence-linked)
- .github/workflows/ci.yml with Terratest steps
